task: Replace the 70-byte placeholder app icons with a real KubeMetal icon

events.summary: Binary icon assets and one mistakes-log row only; tauri.conf.json bundle.icon list, runtime code, capabilities and dependencies unchanged.
All six files under src-tauri/icons were 70-byte stubs (icon.png decoded as a 1x1 PNG), so the Dock showed a blank gray tile; owner screenshot.

Added the master SVG (DESIGN.md tokens primary to primaryStrong, white KM) and regenerated 32x32, 128x128, 128x128@2x, icon.png (512), icon.icns and icon.ico with the Tauri CLI; android/ios/store sets the generator also emits were deliberately not committed.

events.scope: Icon file formats and that the Rust crate still builds with the new icon.png
events.summary: file(1) reports valid PNG/ICNS/ICO of the expected sizes; iconutil expands icon.icns to the full 16..512@2x iconset; cargo check in src-tauri finished with exit 0.
Icons are real, valid and compile into the app; not observed in the Dock of a freshly built app, nor in a signed or notarized bundle.
Complete for asset generation, format validation and compile; the on-screen Dock result was not verified.
